name: Source-Witness Space Retraction for Union-Closed Families
statement: For a nonempty union-closed family, the joint space of all concept witnesses strongly deformation retracts onto the image of a continuous section from the joint space retaining only source witnesses. The section preserves all separator coefficients and supplied source witnesses and is rational on rational input.
proof: Fix an upward path from a source to every nonsource and apply the explicit one-element witness extension. Convexity of every fixed-row witness region makes linear interpolation to the selected nonsource witnesses a strong deformation retraction.
